title: Warm and Cool Light
content: The down-facing spotlights fill the kitchen with a warm, yellowy light. By comparison, the light entering through the greenhouse window is bluish or cool.Artisanal Lettuce, plein-air casein, 5 x 8 inchesThe warm and cool add up to white light on the countertops.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)I try to capture this big truth quickly and hang onto it while I sort through the details.
